title: figtracer: provenance from analysis notebook chunks to the figures and tables in lab notes
description: A command-line toolkit that keeps the figures and tables in Markdown lab notes in step with the R and Python notebook chunks that produced them. Each saved figure or table is recorded with its notebook, chunk and git commit in a manifest; labelled Quarto chunks can be re-run headlessly; and numbers written in a note are checked against the saved outputs. It does not depend on a particular analysis or plotting library.
